stories.title: HMRC Begins Automatic MTD for Income Tax Sign-Up from September 2026
stories.summary: HMRC is automatically registering eligible sole traders and landlords for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax who need the service but haven't yet signed up, writing to them from September. Over 436,000 have already submitted their first quarterly update for 2026-27.

stories.title: Tax Update 2026: Simplification, Modernisation and Fairness
stories.summary: The government's Tax Update 2026 package announced a series of measures to reduce administrative burdens, improve certainty and fairness across HMRC's operations, including simplification of tax and customs rules.

stories.title: UK and Belgium Strike Deal to Target Small Boat Gangs
stories.summary: The UK and Belgium have signed an agreement to tackle criminal smuggling gangs operating in the English Channel, strengthening joint law enforcement action to reduce dangerous small boat crossings.

stories.title: New Law to Ban Child-Like Sexual Abuse Dolls
stories.summary: The Home Office announced a new law creating a specific criminal offence for making, selling or owning child-like sexual abuse dolls, with jail terms of up to 5 years.

stories.title: New Immigration Rules Changes: Statement HC 584
stories.summary: The Home Office published a new Statement of Changes to Immigration Rules (HC 584) on 3 September 2026, introducing a series of amendments across visa categories reflecting the government's shift toward stricter enforcement.

agencies.name: FCDO
agencies.description: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — diplomacy, international relations

stories.title: UK and US Fusion Strike Partnership to Accelerate Clean Energy
stories.summary: The UK and US have announced a new fusion energy partnership to accelerate the development of clean energy technology, with the aim of modernising public services and reducing energy costs for Britons.

stories.title: Lindy Cameron Appointed as New FCDO Permanent Under-Secretary
stories.summary: Lindy Cameron, currently British High Commissioner to India, has been appointed as the new Permanent Under-Secretary of the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, replacing the outgoing leadership.

stories.title: Foreign Secretary Statement on Israel-Palestine and Joint Two-State Solution Declaration
stories.summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband delivered an oral statement to the House of Commons on Israel-Palestine, with 12 foreign ministers (including the UK) issuing a joint statement reaffirming support for a two-state solution.

agencies.name: DWP
agencies.description: Department for Work and Pensions — benefits, pensions

stories.title: September 2026 Benefit and Pension Payment Dates Confirmed
stories.summary: DWP has confirmed benefit and pension payment dates for September 2026, including details on Universal Credit, State Pension and cost of living support for households amid ongoing economic pressures.

stories.title: DWP Confirms £739.60 September Payment for Eligible Pensioners
stories.summary: DWP has confirmed a £739.60 September payment for eligible older pensioners under the new State Pension payment schedule, relating to the 4.8% annual uprating in April 2026.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: Bluetongue Latest Situation: Guidance Updated
stories.summary: DEFRA updated its bluetongue guidance covering the current outbreak situation in England, including case numbers, risk level, vaccination coverage and movement restrictions for livestock.

stories.title: English Whisky Gains New Protected Geographical Status
stories.summary: English Whisky has been awarded protected geographical status, safeguarding its reputation, quality standards and production methods, in a boost for the UK's growing spirits industry.

stories.title: Sustainable Farming Incentive 2026: Window 2 Opening 22 September
stories.summary: Following the close of SFI26 Window 1, DEFRA has announced that Window 2 of the Sustainable Farming Incentive will open from 22 September 2026, allowing more farmers to apply for environmental land management payments.

stories.title: Free Rail Travel Expanded to Bereaved Veteran Families for Remembrance Weekend
stories.summary: The MoD announced that free rail travel will be extended to bereaved veteran families for Remembrance weekend events, honouring the sacrifice of fallen service members.

stories.title: UK Forces Join Trilateral Arctic Exercise in High North
stories.summary: UK Armed Forces deployed to the Arctic island of Jan Mayen alongside Norwegian and US allies for a trilateral exercise demonstrating NATO's enhanced capability to operate jointly in the strategically important High North region.

stories.title: UK Armed Forces Pay Tribute at King of Norway's Funeral in Oslo
stories.summary: UK Armed Forces personnel attended and participated in the state funeral of the late King of Norway in Oslo, representing the UK's close ties with the Norwegian royal family and NATO alliance.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: 10th UK-U.S. SME Dialogue Held in Cardiff
stories.summary: Over 80 UK and US small business organisations participated in the 10th UK-U.S. SME Dialogue in Cardiff on 9 September 2026, convened by BIST to strengthen transatlantic business ties and SME collaboration.

stories.title: BIST Launches Consultation on Modernising Corporate Reporting
stories.summary: BIST published a wide-ranging consultation on 7 September 2026 proposing significant reforms to the UK's corporate reporting framework, including changes to Companies Act 2006 requirements on annual reports, sustainability disclosures, and capital maintenance rules.

stories.title: Health Bill 2026-27 Completes Commons Stages — NHS England to Be Abolished
stories.summary: The Health Bill 2026-27, which proposes the abolition of NHS England in the largest NHS reorganisation in more than a decade, completed its House of Commons stages on 8 September 2026 and now proceeds to the House of Lords.
stories.source: House of Commons Library / Kings Fund

stories.title: Over £1.5 Billion to Help NHS Withstand Year-Round Pressure
stories.summary: The government announced over £1.5 billion in additional funding to help the NHS maintain resilience and capacity throughout the year, addressing waiting times and year-round service pressures.

stories.title: Royal Mail Wholesale Price Increases Suspended Pending Ofcom Dispute
stories.summary: Royal Mail's planned wholesale postage price increases of up to 25-33% (due from 5 October 2026) have been suspended while Ofcom considers a formal dispute filed by access customers challenging the scale of the proposed changes.

stories.title: Royal Mail 24/48 Prices Changing from 5 October 2026
stories.summary: Royal Mail has confirmed price changes to its Royal Mail 24 and 48 tracked parcel services from 5 October 2026, with a peak surcharge also applying from 2 November 2026 through to 10 January 2027.
